scope: Targeted qualification for the current English research continuation, not a second daily discovery crawl

datasets.name: AMI manual annotations1.6.2, natural meetings only
datasets.verified: Official annotations CC BY4.0. Genuine natural N meetings distinguishable from S roleplay and B fictitious-scenario material.26 natural EN/IN meetings,51 global IDs,15 with>=3 distinct dates; second independent metadata calculation agrees. All102 natural meeting/channel pairs have word and segment entries. No source-qualified personal Facts established by this metadata screen.
datasets.limits: Original global IDs encode demographics: neutral remapping required.11 natural participants also occur in S/B metadata, so enforce N-only meeting selection. Private local research only; no inferred consent to generative impersonation, no identity enrichment or public raw dialogue. Cross-corpus natural-person disjointness is not proven by incompatible pseudonym systems.
datasets.provenance: Official22,887,865byte archive SHA256b56e5babb2496b8795deeeda7e71178d7fbc9963f94276cf2a3f4b56ebbc9f9d; source access governed by separately frozen policies.

datasets.name: LANA-CASE
datasets.verified: Official release documents spontaneous English conversation and speaker metadata. Posted agreement contains AI training/upload restrictions and recipient signature requirements; ordinary availability is not unrestricted AI-use permission.
datasets.decision: No corpus download, signature, access request or assent. Seek actual licensor clarification only if this dataset becomes indispensable; do not assume local inference plus AI-assisted inspection is exempt. Corpus size does not resolve permission.

datasets.name: OpenYap1K
datasets.verified: Documentation describes1602 familiar-pair conversations,239 stable pseudonymous speaker IDs and recording dates. Access is reviewed/contractual; ASR transcript accuracy is not guaranteed. Redistributability and identifiable likeness restrictions require exact-use review.
datasets.decision: No access request, recipient assent, private corpus acquisition or assumption that text-persona simulation escapes restrictions. Public selected samples are not a qualified independent longitudinal cohort.

datasets.name: ELITR Minuting Corpus
datasets.verified: Primary documentation and paper sections3.4/3.9 describe real meetings and publication consent, but PERSON identifiers are shuffled per meeting.
datasets.decision: No attempt to reverse anonymization. Natural conversations alone do not establish reliable longitudinal speaker-conditioned S/F/H data.

ICSI_alternative.verified: Unopened Bro metadata provides7 previously unexposed target IDs,5 with>=3dates, but1to4 exposed partners per relevant meeting. Bns has9 new target IDs,4 with>=3dates, each relevant meeting with1 exposed partner.
ICSI_alternative.decision: Could support a separately prospective target-speaker-disjoint, partner-overlapping transport study after source qualification; cannot be called fully participant-disjoint independent validation or repair of frozen Bed failure. No bodies read for this check. Prefer licensed external AMI source qualification first.

models.verified: Same model dimensions and raw tokenizer.json/vocab/merges blobs; tokenizer.json Git blob443909a61d429dff23010e5bddd28ff530edda00. EOS differs151643/151645. Both Apache2.0. New matched conversion and generation setup would still require prospective resource/runtime qualification.
models.qwen3_alternative_limit: Qwen3-0.6B Base and the existing posttrained model share core vocabulary/merges but differ in four added tool/think tokens, EOS and trained context configuration. Reusing posttrained chat outputs as a plain-text Base control would confound interface/training.
models.decision: HOLD large RQ3 batch: no validated automatic semantic-quality endpoint. Zero new weights downloaded or model calls. No claim that prospective matched models are already executable or performance-qualified.

conditional_likelihood_option.verified: Fixed local llama.dll exposes tokenization, decode, raw logits and memory-clear primitives. Server n_probs covers generated tokens; generic perplexity scores the wrong region for a conditional target-only endpoint.
conditional_likelihood_option.boundary: A future thin teacher-forced scorer must verify ABI, complete-vocabulary stable log-softmax, target-only positions, token boundary consistency, no answer leakage, KV isolation and independent batched/incremental arithmetic before research use. Such compute must be prospectively bounded/accounted. Actual-continuation predictability is not semantic Persona Fidelity or a unique gold answer.
conditional_likelihood_option.decision: Do not build another general evaluation framework or replace missing semantic evidence with unvalidated NLL. Prioritize qualified real conversational source-provision replication.

literature_scheduler: Same-day scheduled metadata collection already completed; verified automation covers arXiv/Crossref/OpenAlex, not all requested venues and not daily deep AI paper analysis. Primary checks above were targeted prerequisites, not claims of novel papers or peer-reviewed status.
novelty: No new algorithmic originality claim. Native cost decomposition motivates an efficiency baseline, not invention. No semantically validated reliability-fidelity failure yet warrants algorithm expansion.
